text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm cruising through the mall on my day
off when I
spot a familiar face in front of
a boutique.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How about this ring? It has a nice color,
and it's
high-quality. Not a bad choice, if
you ask me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide. You know that's an ear cuff,
right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh?! It looks exactly like a ring... but it's
not...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Sorry, that was a little

disconcerting...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous asked me to help choose a
gift for
Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What do I do?! What do I dooo?! My
marvelous
sense isn't tingling at all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Marvelous, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goody. So, listen. Mayano won a
race! ☆ And
I want to give her a
marvelous present to
celebrate. ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But Mayano says she wants something
that'll help
her become a "grown-up
woman"!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whatever could that be? Is it sweet? Is it
savory?
Is it hot? Cold? I just don't have
a cluuue! ☆
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I ended up here helping
her out.
Taishin's come to lend a hand
too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's always gotta stick her nose in
other
people's business... Anyway, where
did Marvelous
run off to?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's Marvelous for you, such a free
spirit.
Something else must have caught
her eye, so let's
just message her later.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Getting back to the matter at
hand—we've got to
find something that
will help Mayano feel like a
"grown-up
woman."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But how do you define an adult woman
in the first
place? By her age?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Biwa Hayahide, I can't help
feeling
she's getting caught up on the
specifics.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Simpler?
choice_data_list: Why not try thinking a bit more simply?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have a point. If we don't even like
the gift, it
probably won't convey our
feelings very well.
choice_data_list: Just pick whatever the two of you think is best.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Taishin. Let's each find one gift
candidate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some time, they both come back
holding
potential gifts to compare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has chosen red nail
polish, while
Narita Taishin presents a
pair of silver earrings.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now for the impartial opinion. Trainer,
which do
you think would be the better
choice?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you concur with my pick?
choice_data_list: The alluring nail polish Hayahide picked out

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought back to the outfit I wore
for the
recent holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I had my nails done to match, you see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was quite fascinating to see how much
the color
of your nails can affect your
whole look. So, I
thought I'd like for
Mayano to enjoy that same
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I had no idea. So that's how you
felt
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin agrees to the nail polish
idea, and
we settle on the gift.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Congratulations on your
marvelous
victory! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You got me a present?! And it's nail polish?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is super grown-up! With this on, I'll definitely look extra mature, don'tcha think? ♪ Thank you all so much! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It looks like our gift was quite a
hit. It was
well worth us putting our
heads together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ohh... Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I remembered what I got Hayahide
for the
recent holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I gave her a pair of silver earrings too... I
figured
they didn't look bad, so...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow. You must've put some thought
into finding
an accessory that matched
my outfit so nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was just—anyway, hurry up and
make a
decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide agrees to the earrings
idea, and
we settle on the gift.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Congratulations on your
marvelous
victory! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You got me a present?! And it's earrings?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is super grown-up! Wearing these will make me, like, chic and cool, right? ♪ Thank you all so much! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh... But what kind of outfit would go
well with
these? Pleeease, you've gotta
help me pick. ☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You're saying we're not done
yet?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, it just goes to show how
trustworthy
we are. Nothing makes me
happier than helping
out the younger
students.
